meta.description: Stable US-GAAP concept groupings and derived KPI definitions. Tags are local names under taxonomy us-gaap; filers may use alternates—lists are preference order for resolution.

accounting.notes: Merge reference/sources/accounting (acct_facts.csv + acct_facts_overlay.json) into generated/us_gaap_account_map.json; load at runtime via sec_edgar.reference_data.load_accounting_by_concept.

gross_margin.notes: Skipped if revenue is null or zero.

inventory_turns_sales_basis.notes: Sales-based turns; not COGS-based inventory turnover.

working_capital_proxy.notes: Uses zero for missing operands when at least one present.

eps_basic_computed.notes: EPS = Net Income / Shares Outstanding, using weighted-average basic shares; computed, not the filer's reported EarningsPerShareBasic. Value is USD per share (unit column says ratio). Source: finance cheat sheet shared at https://x.com/CompoundingW/status/2114932373280460836 (docs/finance-formulas.md).

return_on_equity.notes: ROE = Net Income / Shareholders' Equity, period-end equity (not average). Source: finance cheat sheet shared at https://x.com/CompoundingW/status/2114932373280460836 (docs/finance-formulas.md).

return_on_assets.notes: ROA = Net Income / Total Assets, period-end assets (not average). Source: finance cheat sheet shared at https://x.com/CompoundingW/status/2114932373280460836 (docs/finance-formulas.md).

debt_to_equity.notes: D/E = Total Debt / Shareholders' Equity. total_debt prefers the combined short+long-term tag, then LongTermDebt (includes current maturities); filers that tag short-term borrowings separately are understated. Source: finance cheat sheet shared at https://x.com/CompoundingW/status/2114932373280460836 (docs/finance-formulas.md).

current_ratio.notes: Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities. Source: finance cheat sheet shared at https://x.com/CompoundingW/status/2114932373280460836 (docs/finance-formulas.md).

quick_ratio.notes: Quick (acid-test) Ratio = (Current Assets - Inventory) / Current Liabilities. Skipped when no inventory fact (current_ratio then applies). Source: finance cheat sheet shared at https://x.com/CompoundingW/status/2114932373280460836 (docs/finance-formulas.md).

ebitda.notes: EBITDA = Net Income + Interest + Taxes + Depreciation + Amortization; XBRL reports D&A as one combined tag. Source: finance cheat sheet shared at https://x.com/CompoundingW/status/2114932373280460836 (docs/finance-formulas.md).

interest_coverage.notes: Interest Coverage = EBIT / Interest Expense, with OperatingIncomeLoss as the EBIT proxy. Source: finance cheat sheet shared at https://x.com/CompoundingW/status/2114932373280460836 (docs/finance-formulas.md).

balance_sheet.description: Point-in-time; facts typically use end date without start.

income_statement.description: Duration; facts often include start and end.
